pilot.note: 512 task episodes and the probes the coverage targets need; splits 0/1 by family

production.note: 18,000 task episodes (nominal and difficult in the pilot ratio) and the probes at 10 times their pilot counts; splits 0/1, 90/10 inside each family: 16,197 + 1,803 task and 9,450 + 1,050 probe episodes

test.note: sealed test: 2,000 task episodes and the probes at their pilot counts; all split 2

extra.note: supplementary training data (2026-10-10): twice the production count of each task family (collect with --families for the hard ones); all split 0, so the production validation episodes stay the validation set

families.name: nominal
families.note: approach, descend, close, lift to a random height, hold, move while holding (half), lower, release, retreat

families.name: off_centre
families.note: grasp offset along the jaw width, the closing axis and the height; the cube can turn or slip in the grasp

families.name: one_sided
families.note: only one jaw touches the cube on the table: a fixed-jaw side push, a moving-jaw swat or a fingertip tap

families.name: near_miss
families.note: the jaws close 15-35 mm off the cube centre: an edge graze or nothing; lift, lower, release

families.name: weak_closure
families.note: the jaw target is set at the measured contact angle plus a small opening; fast lift and shake; slip or drop

families.name: drop
families.note: grasp and lift, then the jaw opens in the air: cube flight, table impact and tumbling

families.name: push
families.note: closed jaws lowered beside the cube push it across the table

families.name: free_arm
families.note: random joint-space motion of the arm; the cube rests out of reach

families.name: cube_flight
families.note: cube thrown upwards above the table (1-2.2 m/s, spin up to 25 rad/s, landings up to about 2.6 m/s): flight, impacts, tumbling until it rests (1 s); the arm moves freely

families.name: cube_table
families.note: cube released just above the table with sliding velocity and spin: impacts, sliding, settling (1 s)

families.name: jaw_fixed
families.note: cube released just above the fixed jaw's inner face (held up, sloped along the finger), in the air; it rests or slides, then a fast arm move tips the face over: the cube falls to the table (or onto the arm base, which ends the episode) or stays on the gripper against a palm block

families.name: jaw_moving
families.note: cube released just above the moving jaw's inner face (held up, sloped along the finger), in the air; it rests or slides, then a fast arm move tips the face over: the cube falls to the table (or onto the arm base, which ends the episode) or stays on the gripper against a palm block

families.name: step_arm
families.note: step commands of the arm joints and the jaw (held 0.1-0.6 s), servo saturation without contact; the cube rests out of reach (2 s). Only in campaign extra. The 2026-10-10 collection drew targets 0.05 rad inside the limits (15 % of its episodes passed a limit by up to 33 mrad); the code now keeps 0.12 rad
